patterns.note: A fixed, left-aligned navigation block with the logo and menu items remains visible and accessible throughout the page scroll.
The site uses a high-contrast palette, pairing bright, almost neon accent colors (green, blue, red) with a neutral base of black, white, and a warm light beige.

The initial black screen transitions to reveal the hero section with a light beige background and concentric circle pattern, which then gives way to a plain white background for mid-page content, and finally returns to the beige concentric pattern for the footer.
The hero section features an extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif heading that dominates the initial viewport, contrasting with smaller, lighter sans-serif text for subheadings and navigation.
Distinct sections are visually separated by alternating background treatments: a recurring light beige with concentric circles for the hero and footer, and a clean white for intermediate content.

technique_notes: The page employs an initial full-screen overlay or loading state (black screen) that transitions to reveal the main hero content upon load or initial scroll interaction.
Backgrounds are designed to change dynamically as the user scrolls, creating distinct visual sections. This involves swapping out full-width background images or colors at specific scroll points.
A sticky navigation element is anchored to the top-left corner, ensuring constant access to primary menu links regardless of scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif hero text (~5-6x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif subheadings and standard body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing in hero and footer sections, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic initial black screen reveal, followed by a bold, oversized hero text against a recurring concentric circle background. The use of bright, almost neon accent colors against a largely neutral palette provides a playful yet sophisticated contrast.
